blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Switchboard Upgrade Cost in Braeside?
blogPosts.excerpt: Wondering about switchboard upgrade costs in Braeside? We break down pricing, factors affecting your quote and why upgrading to RCD protection is essential for Victorian homes.
body: If you own a home or business in Braeside, VIC, one of the most important electrical upgrades you can make is replacing an outdated switchboard. Many older properties in Melbourne's south-east still rely on ceramic fuse boxes that were never designed to handle the electrical demands of modern households. With air conditioners, induction cooktops, EV chargers and multiple high-draw appliances, an overloaded switchboard creates a genuine fire and electrocution risk. At ADJ Contracting, we perform switchboard upgrades across Braeside every week, and pricing depends on several key factors.

The cost of a switchboard upgrade in Braeside typically ranges from $800 to $2,500 for residential properties, depending on the size of your home, the number of circuits and whether you need additional RCD (residual current device) protection. A basic upgrade for a small two-bedroom unit might sit around $800 to $1,200, while a larger family home with six or more circuits could cost between $1,500 and $2,500. If your property requires a full meter box relocation or new mains connection from the street, expect pricing at the higher end of that range.

Victorian building regulations and the AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules require specific safety features in modern switchboards. Since 2018, all new and upgraded switchboards in Victoria must include RCD protection on every power and lighting circuit. RCDs are designed to trip and cut power in milliseconds when they detect an earth fault, potentially preventing fatal electric shocks. Many older Braeside homes only have one or two RCDs covering the entire property, which is no longer considered adequate protection. Upgrading ensures your family and your property meet current legal requirements.

When we quote a switchboard upgrade at your Braeside property, we assess several factors that influence the final cost. The condition and accessibility of your existing wiring plays a major role — if cables are brittle or damaged, additional rewiring may be necessary. The number of circuits in your home matters too, as each circuit needs its own breaker and RCD protection. We also consider whether your property needs a demand upgrade from your electricity distributor, which is common when adding high-draw systems like solar inverters or Tesla Powerwalls.

Braeside's mix of older weatherboard homes and newer builds means we encounter a wide variety of switchboard configurations. Many properties in the 3195 postcode area were built before modern electrical standards, and their switchboards often show signs of wear, corrosion or makeshift repairs. During a typical upgrade, ADJ Contracting removes the entire old fuse box and installs a new metal-enclosed switchboard with clearly labelled circuit breakers, RCDs and safety switches. The process usually takes two to four hours, and your power will be off for a portion of that time.

The most compelling reason to upgrade your Braeside switchboard is safety. According to Electrical Safety Office data, outdated switchboards are a leading cause of residential electrical fires in Victoria. Modern RCDs reduce the risk of electrocution by up to 99 percent, making them the single most important safety feature in your home. Beyond safety, a new switchboard can also increase your property's value and satisfy insurance requirements, as some Australian insurers now require RCD protection across all circuits. It is an investment that protects your family and your finances.

If you are considering a switchboard upgrade in Braeside, the best first step is a free on-site assessment from a licensed electrician. At ADJ Contracting, we inspect your existing switchboard, assess your wiring and provide a fixed, upfront quote with no hidden charges. We carry a full range of modern switchboards and can often complete the upgrade the same day. Serving Braeside, Keysborough, Mordialloc and surrounding suburbs, we are your local switchboard specialists. Call us today on 03 9587 3661 or email admin@adj.com.au to book your free assessment.

blogPosts.title: Electrical Safety Inspection Guide for Braeside Rental Properties
blogPosts.excerpt: Braeside landlords and property managers: learn what is required in an electrical safety inspection, Victorian compliance rules and how to keep your rental properties safe and legal.
body: Owning a rental property in Braeside comes with significant electrical safety obligations under Victorian law. The Residential Tenancies Act and Electrical Safety Act require landlords to ensure all electrical installations in their rental properties are safe and in good working order at the start of every tenancy. This means functional power points, working light fixtures, a compliant switchboard and properly functioning smoke alarms. For Braeside landlords, arranging regular electrical safety inspections is not just best practice — it is a legal requirement that protects your tenants and limits your liability.

A comprehensive electrical safety inspection for a Braeside rental property involves testing every accessible electrical component in the home. A licensed electrician will inspect the switchboard, test each power point and light circuit, check the earth fault loop impedance and verify that all RCDs are functioning correctly. Smoke alarms are tested for placement compliance and battery operation, and any visible wiring damage or deterioration is documented. The entire process typically takes one to two hours for a standard three-bedroom home and results in a detailed compliance report.

Victorian legislation mandates that rental properties must have working smoke alarms in every bedroom, in hallways connecting bedrooms and on each level of the home. Since 2017, all smoke alarms in Victorian rentals must be hardwired with battery backup and interconnected so that when one alarm sounds, all alarms sound simultaneously. Many older Braeside rental properties still have standalone battery-operated alarms that do not meet current standards. During an inspection, ADJ Contracting identifies non-compliant alarms and can upgrade them to meet Victorian requirements on the same visit.

The cost of an electrical safety inspection for a Braeside rental property is modest compared to the potential consequences of non-compliance. A standard inspection typically costs between $150 and $300, depending on the size of the property and the number of circuits. If defects are found, we provide a detailed report outlining each issue, the associated risk and recommended repairs with fixed pricing. Victorian penalties for landlords who fail to maintain safe electrical installations can reach thousands of dollars, making a routine inspection an essential investment in risk management.

Braeside's rental market includes a mix of older established homes and newer developments, each presenting different electrical challenges. Older properties in the 3195 area may have original wiring that has deteriorated over decades, aluminium cabling that has become brittle, or switchboards that have been modified by unlicensed handymen. These issues are common and often invisible until a proper inspection is conducted. At ADJ Contracting, we recommend Braeside landlords schedule an electrical safety inspection every two to three years, or whenever a tenancy changes, to ensure ongoing compliance and tenant safety.

For Braeside property managers handling multiple rentals, establishing a regular inspection schedule with a trusted local electrician streamlines compliance and reduces long-term costs. ADJ Contracting offers priority scheduling for property managers across Braeside, Keysborough and surrounding suburbs, with detailed digital reports delivered within 24 hours of each inspection. We maintain records of all previous inspections, making it easy to demonstrate compliance during audits or insurance claims. Contact our team today to arrange electrical safety inspections for your Braeside rental portfolio.

blogPosts.title: Do You Need a Lighting Upgrade at Your Braeside Property?
blogPosts.excerpt: Is your Braeside home or business still using outdated lighting? Discover how an LED lighting upgrade cuts energy costs, improves safety and enhances your property.
body: Lighting technology has advanced dramatically in recent years, and many Braeside homes and businesses are still running outdated halogen, incandescent or CFL systems that waste energy and underperform. If you find yourself replacing globes frequently, dealing with dim or flickering lights, or noticing unusually high electricity bills, it may be time for a professional lighting upgrade. ADJ Contracting has helped hundreds of Braeside property owners transition to modern LED lighting systems that deliver brighter, more consistent illumination at a fraction of the running cost.

The energy savings from upgrading to LED lighting in a typical Braeside home are significant. A standard halogen downlight consumes around 50 watts, while an equivalent LED uses just 8 to 12 watts. For a home with 20 downlights, switching to LEDs can save over 700 watts of continuous draw, translating to hundreds of dollars per year on electricity bills. In commercial spaces like offices, warehouses and retail shops in Braeside, the savings are even more substantial, with LED upgrades typically paying for themselves within 12 to 18 months.

Beyond energy efficiency, a lighting upgrade improves the quality of light in your Braeside property. Modern LEDs offer a range of colour temperatures from warm white at 3000K to cool daylight at 6000K, allowing you to create the right atmosphere in every room. High colour rendering index LEDs reveal true colours more accurately, which is particularly important in kitchens, bathrooms and retail displays. ADJ Contracting helps Braeside residents choose the optimal colour temperature and fitting type for each space, ensuring both functionality and comfort.

For Braeside businesses, a professional lighting upgrade delivers measurable benefits beyond reduced electricity costs. Well-designed commercial lighting improves employee productivity, reduces eye strain and creates a safer working environment. Retail spaces in the Braeside industrial precinct and surrounding commercial areas benefit from improved product visibility and customer experience. ADJ Contracting works with local business owners to design and install commercial lighting systems that meet Workplace Health and Safety standards while maximising visual comfort and energy efficiency across offices, warehouses and shopfronts.

Outdoor lighting is another area where Braeside property owners see immediate benefits from an upgrade. Replacing old halogen floodlights with LED security lights reduces energy consumption while providing brighter, more reliable illumination for driveways, pathways and building exteriors. Motion-sensor LED floodlights are particularly popular for Braeside homes and businesses, offering enhanced security without running lights all night. ADJ Contracting installs weather-rated outdoor LED lighting solutions designed to withstand Melbourne's variable climate, from hot summers to cold, damp winters.

If your Braeside property is ready for a lighting upgrade, ADJ Contracting provides a comprehensive service from initial consultation through to installation and testing. We assess your current lighting setup, identify the most impactful improvements and provide a fixed quote before any work begins. Our electricians handle everything from simple globe replacements to complete lighting rewiring for homes and businesses across Braeside, Keysborough, Mordialloc and surrounding suburbs. Contact us today on 03 9587 3661 to discuss your lighting upgrade options.

blogPosts.title: Power Point Installation Costs in Braeside: What to Expect
blogPosts.excerpt: Planning to add power points in your Braeside home or office? We cover typical costs, factors affecting pricing and why professional installation matters for safety.
body: Running out of power points is one of the most common electrical frustrations for homeowners and businesses in Braeside. Whether you are setting up a home office, adding appliances to the kitchen or installing equipment in a commercial workspace, insufficient power points lead to dangerous double adapter chains and overloaded circuits. ADJ Contracting installs additional power points throughout Braeside properties, ensuring each new outlet is properly wired, circuit-protected and fully compliant with Australian electrical standards and the AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules.

The cost of installing additional power points in a Braeside home depends on several factors, including the type of outlet, the complexity of the wiring run and accessibility of your existing circuits. A standard single power point installation typically costs between $150 and $250, while a double power point ranges from $180 to $300. If the new outlet requires running cable through a concrete slab, brick wall or under the floor, additional labour costs may apply. For commercial installations in Braeside, pricing varies based on the number of outlets and the electrical load requirements.

There are several types of power points available for Braeside properties, each suited to different applications. Standard 10-amp general purpose outlets suit most household needs, while 15-amp outlets are ideal for high-draw appliances like air conditioners and ovens. Weatherproof outdoor power points are essential for Braeside patios, gardens and pool areas, featuring IP-rated enclosures that protect against moisture and dust. USB-integrated power points are increasingly popular in Braeside homes, allowing direct phone and tablet charging without bulky adapters. ADJ Contracting advises on the best outlet type for each location.

Kitchen and bathroom power point installations in Braeside require special consideration under Australian electrical safety regulations. Power points within three metres of a water source must be protected by safety switches and installed at specific heights and distances from basins, showers and cooktops. Braeside homes with older wiring may also need circuit upgrades to safely handle the additional load from modern kitchen appliances. ADJ Contracting ensures every power point installation in wet areas meets current Victorian electrical safety requirements, giving you complete peace of mind.

For Braeside businesses, strategic power point placement is critical for productivity and safety. Offices need adequate outlets at workstations, while warehouses and workshops in the Braeside industrial area require heavy-duty three-phase outlets for machinery and equipment. ADJ Contracting works with Braeside business owners to plan power point layouts that support their operational needs, comply with workplace electrical safety standards and allow for future expansion. We also install dedicated circuits for high-draw equipment to prevent overloads and nuisance tripping.

When you choose ADJ Contracting for power point installation in your Braeside property, you are getting licensed electricians who prioritise safety and quality. Every new outlet is tested for correct polarity, earth continuity and RCD operation before we consider the job complete. We use quality HPM and Clipsal outlets rated for Australian conditions, backed by our workmanship guarantee. Serving Braeside, Keysborough, Mordialloc, Aspendale and surrounding suburbs, we are ready to add the power points your property needs. Call 03 9587 3661 for a free quote.
